question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
WITH june_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT calendar_year, week_date_formatted, CAST(week_date_formatted AS DATE) as wd
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
  WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020) AND month_number IN (5, 6, 7)
),
before_ranked AS (
  SELECT calendar_year, week_date_formatted, wd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY wd DESC) as rn
  FROM june_weeks
  WHERE wd < MAKE_DATE(calendar_year, 6, 15)
),
after_ranked AS (
  SELECT calendar_year, week_date_formatted, wd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY wd ASC) as rn
  FROM june_weeks
  WHERE wd >= MAKE_DATE(calendar_year, 6, 15)
),
before_weeks AS (
  SELECT calendar_year, week_date_formatted
  FROM before_ranked WHERE rn <= 4
),
after_weeks AS (
  SELECT calendar_year, week_date_formatted
  FROM after_ranked WHERE rn <= 4
),
before_sales AS (
  SELECT bw.calendar_year, SUM(cws.sales) as total_sales_before
  FROM before_weeks bw
  JOIN cleaned_weekly_sales cws ON bw.calendar_year = cws.calendar_year 
    AND bw.week_date_formatted = cws.week_date_formatted
  GROUP BY bw.calendar_year
),
after_sales AS (
  SELECT aw.calendar_year, SUM(cws.sales) as total_sales_after
  FROM after_weeks aw
  JOIN cleaned_weekly_sales cws ON aw.calendar_year = cws.calendar_year 
    AND aw.week_date_formatted = cws.week_date_formatted
  GROUP BY aw.calendar_year
)
SELECT bs.calendar_year,
       ROUND(1.0 * (asales.total_sales_after - bs.total_sales_before) / bs.total_sales_before * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM before_sales bs
JOIN after_sales asales ON bs.calendar_year = asales.calendar_year
ORDER BY bs.calendar_year
